name: Ningyo to Hoshi Musubi no Kaizoku
source:
The year is 1615, set in a port town on the Caribbean coast. 

You are a mermaid who longs for the world on land. One day, you rescue Orion, a pirate found drifting at sea and covered in wounds. He's clumsy, yet somehow warmhearted, and as you spend your days together on the shore, you find yourselves drawn to one another, falling into a love that can never be...

This is a heart-stirring tale of tragic romance where the sea and the stars collide.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/14550]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
1615年，加勒比海沿岸的一座港口小镇。

你是一条向往陆地世界的人鱼。某天，你救起了浑身是伤、在海上漂流的海盗奥利安。他虽然有些笨拙，内心却格外温柔；在海岸边朝夕相处的日子里，你们不由自主地被彼此吸引，坠入了一段注定无法相守的恋情……

这是一曲海洋与繁星交汇、令人心潮澎湃的凄美悲恋物语。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/14550]Novelgame[/url]]
